components.title: Text Tokens
components.description: Input text strings are tokenized into token IDs using Liquid vocabulary (vocab_size: 128,000).

components.title: Token Embeddings
components.description: Maps token IDs into 2048-dimensional continuous vector embeddings. Word embeddings are tied to LM output projection.

components.title: LFM3 Hybrid Decoder (24 Layers)
components.description: 24 configured layers combining 13 GatedDeltaNet short convolutions, 6 full attention layers, and 5 sliding window attention layers. Uses sandwich normalization.

components.title: Causal LM Head
components.description: Final RMSNorm projection mapping hidden states back to vocabulary logit distribution.

components.title: Generated Text
components.description: Autoregressively sampled token sequence output. Verified in P1 text client and P6 multimodal orchestration.

components.title: Image / Sampled Video Input
components.description: RGB pixels processed with axial rotary embeddings and spatial patch merging.

components.title: Patchifier & Spatial Merging
components.description: Transforms image patches into sequence tokens using 2x downsampling.

components.title: 14-Layer Vision Encoder
components.description: 14-layer encoder (8 conv, 6 full attention) extracting deep visual representations.

components.title: Multimodal Projector (MLP)
components.description: Two-layer GELU MLP with LayerNorm projecting 1024 visual dim -> 4096 intermediate -> 2048 text dim.

components.title: Text Tokens & Prompt
components.description: Text query or OCR instruction accompanying visual input.

components.title: Token Embeddings
components.description: Text token embeddings mapped to 2048 hidden dimensions.

components.title: Visual Feature Insertion
components.description: Replaces image placeholder tokens with projected visual feature vectors inside unified sequence.

components.title: LFM3 Text Backbone (24 Layers)
components.description: 24 hybrid decoder layers (13 conv, 6 full attention, 5 sliding attention) processing unified multimodal state.

components.title: LM Output Head
components.description: Generates text tokens representing visual query answer or OCR extraction.

components.title: Text Answer / Transcription
components.description: Evaluated in P2: 10/10 exact matches in Direct VL vs 9/10 in Modular cascade.

components.title: 16 kHz Audio Stream / Waveform
components.description: Input speech converted to 128-mel spectrogram frames at 16 kHz.

components.title: Audio Downsampler & Front-End
components.description: Initial convolutional downsampler mapping 128 mels -> 256 conv dim -> 768 encoder dim.

components.title: 17-Layer Causal Audio Encoder
components.description: 17-layer hybrid encoder (10 conv, 7 full attention) with 32-step sliding window.

components.title: Audio Projector
components.description: Linear mapping projecting 768 audio encoder states into 2048-dim text backbone space.

components.title: Text Tokens / System Prompt

components.title: Token Embeddings
components.description: Text token embeddings mapped to 2048 hidden dimensions.

components.title: Audio Feature Insertion

components.title: LFM3 Text Backbone (24 Layers)
components.description: 24 hybrid decoder layers performing joint acoustic-semantic reasoning.

components.title: Text Output (Transcript / ASR)
components.description: Speech-to-text transcript output or textual reasoning stream.

components.title: Depthformer (3 Layers)
components.description: 3 full-attention layers predicting 12 codebook tokens across maskgit steps.

components.title: LiquidCodec Neural Decoder
components.description: Quantized neural audio codec decoding acoustic tokens into continuous audio waveform.

components.title: Speech Output (24 kHz Audio)
components.description: Native speech-to-speech output. Evaluated in P3: 13.95s median latency vs 20.18s–27.70s for modular cascades.
